review_comments: If it casts `null` as int. The return type would be inferred as `decimal` when building aggregation. But the schema is int (correct type). Which makes execution panic when fetching the results.
why casts null as int will cause return type to be infereed as decimal? would you please point it out (I am not clear about this, and I didn't found it myself, please let me know)
